newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel talked steady with low avail.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel talked steady with low avail.

text.p: European low sulphur straight-run was largely unchanged on Tuesday with one seller citing a shortage of supplies, while Russian high sulphur straight-run was firmer with very low avails.
An Irish refiner said it quoted $103/$104 fob for its 0.5-0.7 percent material, and that it received some enquiries from England and other northwest European countries.
"It's been a quiet day. If a deal gets done it will be probably around $102/$103 but I doubt anything will be done today," a trader with the refiner said.
